name: neuroarxiv
description: Grounds architecture decisions in real arXiv prior art before implementation.

interface.longDescription: Reads real arXiv papers in isolated passes, scores and clusters the findings, then converges on one cited recommendation with a first step and known pitfalls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use NeuroArxiv before committing to non-trivial architecture, algorithms, ML or systems techniques, or protocols.
